description:
Search memories by relevance. Up to 32 results.

Query = ALL nouns from the user's message, not just the main one (ranking is automatic).
  "How does the app cache API calls?" -> "app cache api calls"
complete=false results are truncated -> memory_retrieve(id) for full content.
Auto-includes all your shared collections (fan-out).

collection_filter.description: Limit to one collection name, or "personal". Omit=all. A slug this namespace holds no grant on (even one the account can list elsewhere) returns 0 rows plus a no_grant explanation, never silence.

expand.description: Full content for all results (~16K tokens/page). Dedicated research agents only.

name: memory_search
